QUICK READ / WALLS & MATERIALS

Office wall designs.

Choose a wall finish for more than the photograph.

Three ideas to take into your workplace conversation.

01 / 03

Give each surface a job

A wall can guide visitors, provide writable space, support acoustic treatment or carry a small moment of brand identity. Decide what it needs to do before adding decorative layers.

Next idea ↓
02 / 03

Check the everyday contact points

Review cleanability, edges, joints and likely wear around desks and circulation routes. Compare physical samples in the actual light rather than relying only on a small screen image.

Next idea ↓
03 / 03

Resolve what sits behind it

Sockets, access panels, doors and equipment can interrupt a seemingly simple elevation. Coordinate these details early so the finish does not create an obstacle to maintenance.

Put it in your brief ↗
A PRACTICAL TAKEAWAY

Before you decide.

  • Name the functional purpose of each proposed finish.
  • Compare samples beside adjacent materials.
  • Record cleaning and replacement requirements.
